exposure_equation_from_code.01.9: N=max(2, ceil(L)+1) per pixel, equal weights, same trajectory

synthetic.point_response_note: The synthetic point at (32,32) with strength 0.40 smears toward the corner and the geometric endpoint is outside the 256² frame. Raw far-end metrics, especially forward-line max=45, include bilinear/splat clamp at the border. In-bounds metrics truncate the profile to samples whose query coordinate is inside the image. 01.8 vs 01.9 continuity is already decided on the in-bounds portion: 01.8 has gaps (active_fraction 0.62, zeros between beads); 01.9 never drops to zero (active_fraction 1.0). Dense peak_count remains high because bilinear/uint8 ripple still creates local maxima on a filled path; peak_count is not a copy-count.

04_forward_line.label: forward line splat
04_forward_line.normalization: forward deposit of source intensity along motion segment; energy approximately conserved per source pixel

ghost_library.candidate_domain: padded artifact crops, not full-resolution permutations

visual_observations.01_fixed_16_box: Discrete repeated copies of book spines, skeleton fingers, and candle flames. Matches 01.10 strong exposure (byte-identical full image).
visual_observations.02_dense_box: Stepping reduced; path looks more filled. Structured objects still read as stacked transformed copies, not a photographic streak. Confirms 01.9.
visual_observations.03_weighted_dense: Envelope change only. Copies remain readable. No material structured-object improvement.
visual_observations.04_forward_line: Different texture (more linear/fibrous). Skeleton fingers and candle flames still read as repeated structure. Not a drop-in continuous integral of the 01.8 gather.
visual_observations.05_prefilter_dense: Most reduction in readable repeated structure, by softening source high-frequency content before accumulation. Crops look hazier. Skeleton fingers still show residual stepping. Mean crop energy stays with the dense-box family, not darker.
visual_observations.candidate_domain: Operators other than 01.8 were evaluated on padded 01.10 artifact crops, not full-resolution Ghost Library permutations.

decision_answers.1: YES. 01.8 fixed-16 produces visibly discrete beads on the synthetic point (in-bounds peak_to_valley 0.94, active_fraction 0.62, zeros between taps) and stepped copies of lines and squares.
decision_answers.2: YES for the point path being filled. 01.9 dense sampling converts the isolated beads into a substantially continuous streak (active_fraction 1.0, no zero gaps). Residual peak_count/p2v=0.60 is bilinear/quantization ripple on a filled path, not 16 isolated copies. Structured squares/lines also become filled wedges rather than 16-count combs.
decision_answers.3: Dense sampling removes empty gaps between taps. It still averages transformed copies of structured source content, so Ghost Library objects remain readable as copies along the path.
decision_answers.4: NO. Triangular weighting changes the brightness envelope (source-end dim, mid-path brighter) but does not materially change structured-object copy appearance on Ghost Library crops.
decision_answers.5: YES it differs (source-centric line kernel, edge clamp, fibrous texture) but it does not cleanly outperform dense dest-gather as a photographic streak of the same 01.8 trajectory. Not a replacement reconstruction of the existing integral.
decision_answers.6: YES, modestly. Sigma=1 prefilter most reduces recognizable repeated structure by lowering source spatial bandwidth before accumulation. It also softens the crop. Residual copies remain on skeleton fingers. Energy stays comparable to dense box.
decision_answers.7: A plus F: sampling density is not the remaining problem; structured-content integration along a long single-frame path is. E is the only in-operator family that visibly reduced copy readability, and it does so by destroying high-frequency structure. Do not densify taps or retune shutter weights next.

letter_notes.A: Supported. Fixed-16 is discrete; dense point response is a filled streak; Ghost Library structured objects still look duplicated.
letter_notes.B: Not primary. Dense point response is rippled but not meaningfully gapped. Sparse-sampling is not the remaining Ghost Library issue.
letter_notes.C: Not supported. Temporal weighting did not materially change structured copies.
letter_notes.D: Not supported as a better reconstruction of the same integral. Forward splat is a different operator and is contaminated at the synthetic corner by clamp.
letter_notes.E: Supported as the only tested family that reduced recognizable copies, via modest source prefiltering, with a softness cost.
letter_notes.F: Also supported. No candidate produced a continuous photographic streak of structured Ghost Library content while retaining that structure. The artifact may be inherent to baking large displacement of structured content into one still.

classification.hypothesis_for_01_12: UNTESTED. 01.12 should determine whether a useful baked-exposure regime exists where trajectory displacement remains strong enough to provide a meaningful Camotion motion cue while structured-object duplication remains acceptable. Characterize path length / exposure strength against source spatial bandwidth, using the existing 01.8 gather and a very small controlled matrix. Do not treat this as parameter optimization. If no useful regime exists, that would motivate leaving exposure-operator tuning rather than continuing to search for another integration kernel. Do not promote any 01.11 candidate. Do not densify taps. Do not retune shutter weights as the next experiment.
reviewed_conclusion: 01.8 fixed-16 exposure contains discrete sampling artifacts.
01.9 dense <=1 px sampling converts the local point response into a continuous, though rippled, streak.
Structured Ghost Library features nevertheless continue to read as transformed copies.
Therefore sparse trajectory sampling is not the dominant remaining cause.
Triangular temporal weighting did not materially reduce structured copies.
Forward line-splat is a different operator, not a better reconstruction of the existing destination-gather integral.
Sigma=1 prefiltering was the only tested family that reduced copy readability, and did so by softening source spatial structure.
No tested 01.11 operator produced a clearly superior continuous photographic streak while preserving structured content.

metric_definitions.path_length_pixels: Euclidean length of the local outgoing smear segment q -> q + v[q]*strength in pixel units. This is a local empirical point response, not a globally shift-invariant PSF.
metric_definitions.peak_count: Number of 1D local maxima with value >= 10% of the profile max. Counts bilinear/quantization ripple as well as isolated beads; not a quality score.
metric_definitions.peak_to_valley: (max-min)/max on samples whose luminance is >= 5% of the profile max (the active streak).
metric_definitions.active_fraction: Fraction of profile samples with luminance >= 5% of the profile max.
metric_definitions.integrated_intensity: Trapezoidal integral of luminance versus distance along the smear segment.
metric_definitions.source_end_mean: Mean luminance of the first 10% of profile samples (near the source point).
metric_definitions.far_end_mean: Mean luminance of the last 10% of profile samples.
metric_definitions.energy: Whole-image luminance mean/max/sum and fraction of pixels with luma > 0.5. Used to check that candidates are not “better” merely by going darker.

candidate_2_math.operation: Forward line-splat: each source pixel q deposits its intensity uniformly along q -> q + v[q]*strength with bilinear scatter and <=1 px spacing. Per-pixel deposit weights sum to 1, so each source pixel approximately conserves energy.
candidate_2_math.difference_from_multisample: Existing 01.8/01.9 operators are destination-centric inverse gathers: dest[p] averages bilinear samples of the whole image along p - v[p]*strength*t. Forward splat uses v at the source and reconstructs a line kernel rather than averaging transformed copies. With a spatially varying radial field these are not adjoints. Image-edge clamp can pile splat energy; that is visible at the synthetic corner and is not a photographic improvement.

normalization.01_fixed_16_box: Equal-weight convex combination, N=16. uint8 rounding after average.
normalization.02_dense_box: Equal-weight convex combination, per-pixel N. uint8 rounding after average.
normalization.03_weighted_dense: Triangular weights normalized to sum 1 (convex combination) on the 01.9 tap set. uint8 rounding after weighted average.
normalization.04_forward_line: Source-energy conserving deposits (not a convex combination of destination samples). Whole-image synthetic luma sum 122036 vs source 122145. uint8 clip plus edge clamp can locally concentrate energy.
normalization.05_prefilter_dense: Gaussian sigma=1 per channel, then 01.9 equal-weight convex combination. Whole-image energy stays comparable to dense box.
